rationale: Vellum move carve P9 (R5 2.3 row P9, DECISIONS D3): split the design subsystem into link targets without moving or renaming any file. pulp-design-ir (header-only DesignIR value types: design_ir.hpp plus design_source_types.hpp, split out of design_sources.hpp) sits below view-core; the 38 importer/codegen sources formerly gated into pulp-view-core compile as pulp-design-import above it; the built-in Pulp Figma Library recognition table moves from RecognitionResolver::with_builtin_library() into the Pulp-owned pulp-design-import-audio-pack (recognition_resolver_with_builtin_library()). The IR JSON/asset/promotion function declarations move to design_ir_io.hpp, reached through design_sources.hpp as before; test_browser_capture_tree.cpp gains that one explicit include, which is the only chromium-authoring-frontend path touched. Every source, parser, codegen output, capture path, render backend and package surface is byte-for-byte the same code; pulp::view and pulp::view-native link all three targets, so consumers see the same surface. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves; Pulp remains the source owner under the 2026-10-04 temporary exception.
